title: CSP Communication — Channels, Select and Fan-out
title_es: Comunicación CSP — Canales, Select y Fan-out
description: Runnable CSP examples: Go pipeline (generator, stages, fan-out/fan-in workers), select with timeout and context cancellation, Rust tokio mpsc channel, and a TypeScript async-generator pipeline.
description_es: Ejemplos CSP ejecutables: pipeline en Go (generator, etapas, workers fan-out/fan-in), select con timeout y cancelación por contexto, canal mpsc de tokio en Rust y pipeline con generadores async en TypeScript.
